# Swarmsite

> Swarmsite makes three finished website designs from an existing site's own words, pictures, logo and colours. You paste the address, compare the three, edit the one you like, pay 79 € once and download it as HTML and CSS to put on any web host.

- Looking at the three designs is free. The price is 79 € once, for the design you keep. There is no subscription.
- Your live site is only read, never changed. Swarmsite does not host the new site; you download the files.
- Three ways to start: a site's address; the address of a first version of an app with up to six screenshots of it; or, with no site, one short form about the business with your own photographs.
- Each design is checked on a desk screen (1440 px) and a phone (390 px) before it is shown. Designs use open-licence typefaces only.
- The download is a zip: index.html, media, fonts, the content as data.json, and a README. The page asks the network for nothing outside that folder.
